  <section class="phs-v3-perspectives" id="population-health" aria-labelledby="perspectives-title">
    <div class="phs-container">
      <div class="phs-v3-sectionlabel">01 / POPULATION HEALTH SCIENCE</div>
      <div class="phs-v3-perspectives-intro">
        <h2 id="perspectives-title">Different perspectives.<br><em>A shared goal.</em></h2>
        <p>Population health science draws on clinical knowledge, public health, epidemiology, and quantitative methods to understand how health and its distribution are shaped across populations.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="phs-v3-discipline-grid">
        <article class="phs-v3-discipline phs-v3-discipline-medicine">
          <span class="phs-v3-discipline-name">Medicine</span>
          <p>How can we diagnose, treat, and care for this patient?</p>
        </article>
        <article class="phs-v3-discipline phs-v3-discipline-public">
          <span class="phs-v3-discipline-name">Public health</span>
          <p>How can we prevent disease and protect communities?</p>
        </article>
        <article class="phs-v3-discipline phs-v3-discipline-epi">
          <span class="phs-v3-discipline-name">Epidemiology</span>
          <p>On a population level, who experiences which health outcomes, when, and why?</p>
        </article>
        <article class="phs-v3-discipline phs-v3-discipline-stats">
          <span class="phs-v3-discipline-name">Biostatistics</span>
          <p>How can we estimate patterns, effects, and uncertainty reliably?</p>
        </article>
      </div>
      <div class="phs-v3-conclusion">
        <span class="phs-v3-conclusion-label">POPULATION HEALTH SCIENCE</span>
        <p><strong>Population health science:</strong> Bringing these perspectives together to understand population-level patterns, determinants, and inequalities in health. And inform ways to improve them.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
